presentation_lexicon.note: Explicit presentation tokens only. A product with no token has presentation UNKNOWN, which is never treated as a match.

tokens.source: Brief §2 p.2 (EXC-107133: 'Two were for the vial, not the pen' for Glucodyne SoloJet)

assumptions: 'up to 1.8 °C' is treated as an interval [0, 1.8] °C, not a fixed offset.
Knowledge time is taken as the incident date 2026-04-11 00:00 UTC; the actual bulletin receipt time is not in the pack.
All readings from TT-2.14.3 are treated as affected regardless of date; the pack does not state an affected date range.

facility_timezone_flags.issue: Memphis, Tennessee observes US Central time (America/Chicago). Registry value is wrong.
Indianapolis canonical IANA zone is America/Indiana/Indianapolis (same offsets as New York since 2007). README says two sites are wrong; the second could not be identified with certainty.

notification_regimes.note: Regimes per tenant. Values marked OBSERVED were inferred from 01_Excursion_Events.reg_window_hours on rows the source flagged reportable and from 13_Volume_And_Cost!R22; Regulatory Affairs must confirm. Whether an individual event is notifiable is a human determination.

T-CAMPOS.open_question: Is day 5 counted to end of local calendar day? Pack encodes 120 elapsed hours.

T-PINNACLE.open_question: Which US state, which timezone, which holiday calendar, and is 'next business day' start or end of day? The pack encodes it as 24 h, which is not equivalent.

T-VIRENT.applicability: India, notifiable products only; product notifiability is not in the pack

product_alias_policy.reason: 07_Alias_Observations has no tenant column and was compiled across the whole platform (00_README!R18). A product alias may be derived from MERIDIAN data; MSA Cl.22 (12_Tenant_Constraints!R6) forbids derived artefacts built on it being used for another customer. Product aliases are therefore not consulted until tenant-attributed and approved. Facility and carrier aliases concern Kestrel-owned entities and are used as provisional hints only.
